nom: belif Aqua Bomb Hydrating Toner with Hyaluronic Acid

avis.texte: I purchased this at a great price as it's my go-to toner - does a great job, feels hydrating and smells awesome!
This was moisturizing and settled my skin so nicely. I clearly saw a difference after using this. I used up my entire bottle and am now a little sad it's sold out. Hopefully they restock soon.

avis.titre: Only toner i will ever need
avis.texte: I love this toner. Several years ago I tried many toners and none really did anything. I then decided to try Belief Toner since I am obsessed with the aqua bomb moisturizer. Five years later, I cannot stop buying this and I hope it's never discontinued. This helps hydrate my skin but it's the best for prepping my skin to help absorb my other product (which I had an issue with before incorporating this product into my skincare routine). I have combo skin leaning on the dryer side. Highly recommend giving it a try! p.s There is fragrance in this product so if you have sensitive skin you might want to be cautious trying this.

avis.titre: The toner I never knew I needed
avis.texte: I'll start by saying I typically don't use toners because they are too drying. I have been using Origins mega mushroom treatment lotion for years before moisturizing because it adds a nice layer of moisture on my skin but I was almost to the bottom of the bottle and llately I've been feeling like I could find something more effective. I've tried other products from Belif and never been disappointed, always happy with the results and never anticipating them to be as good as they ended up. This toner is no exception- my skin actually glows, it isn't irritating or drying and a little bit goes a very long way. If only I had found it years ago!

I have dry sometimes dry/combination mature skin thats very sensitive and prone to breakouts. Toners are a a necessary step in my morning and evening skincare routine. I've tried many toners and all of them either irritated my skin; causes breakouts; or left a film/residue. This toner doesnt do any of that. It does the job and preps your face for the next steps. The best toner for my skin type.

This is my favorite toner. It's cleanses so well and does not dry my skin. I'm always so impressed how hydrating it leaves my skin. I'm so happy I was able to get it on sale and so please stock up if you want to try it.
I have super oily skin so i tend to stray away from hydrating products but this has really helped my skin! Super hydrating and smells good

This is my favorite toner of all time currently. I got it in the mini size and ive been using it for a week and a half. My skin feels so hydrated and smooth when i use it, and it sets the perfect base for the rest of my skincare. The only downside to this toner is that the fragrance is a little overwhelming. I was sort of hesitant to use it at first because i have sensitive skin, but i'm glad i tried it anyway because it hasn't bothered my skin at all :)
This product is nice, but the scent is a little strong. I would repurchase if it was scent free :(

I liked this product. I feel like if you put a lot on, it can really help hydrate your skin. I like to put it on after cleansing, then a light essence / moisturizer, and then put some more on in between steps. Haha. But it works

The 3rd listed ingredient is "Alcohol Denat."… while yes this ingredient can be used for *some* toners, it can cause excessive dryness and disturb the natural barrier on your skin. It can also cause breakouts, skin irritation, and redness. With this being the 3rd ingredient, stay away from this toner if you have dry skin. There are some good products from this brand but just stay away from this one. This is a miss for sure.

avis.titre: Best tonet we've ever used hands down bar none!
avis.texte: Toner is usually drying. Not this! It's so moisturizing while making your skin feel sqreaky clean. It's a marvel.

i use this in the am + pm after cleansing. i notice i break out whenever i skip using this or only use it once a day. i've tried many toners but none of them do it for me like this one. i find many feel like an astringent and dry out my skin but this one feels good on my skin. lasts me a few months. holy grail toner.

I have repurchased this twice now and I swear by this product!! It has helped even out my skin complexion (not 100%) but I can definitely tell a difference in my skin's plumpness. I also think this helps calm down my breakouts as the PH balance really does do something!! I will continue to repurchase. I have super dry skin and I use this at night after I cleanse and it is the only product I use in the morning after gently washing my face with water.
This product is amazing at taking oil and dirt out of the pores! Gives your face such a clean feeling after! 💙💙💙
This toner not only cleanses and moisturizes, it also perks up your skin and tightens it. I have sensitive, acne prone skin and this never caused me a blemish. I will buy this over and over again!
I have dry skin and this is the first toner that actually leaves my skin feeling moisturized

I've tried a lot of "sensitive" and "alcohol free" toners and this is the only one that has ever truly been hydrating and not stripping to my skin. Leaves it feeling fresh and soft without any tightness.

avis.titre: Good but could be better imo
avis.texte: This made my skin feels cooling and soothing After cleansing. It also brings some hydration back! But to me not enough hydration as I would like for the price esp with all the cleansing oil/ balm, exfoliation and face masks I use before applying this! You can find a toner less cheaper and does/have the same effects as this one does. Going to keep searching!

But to me not enough hydration as I would like for the price, esp with all the cleansing oil/ balm, exfoliation and face masks I use before applying this! I have tried so many hydrating toners. This is the most hydrating toner I've ever tried. For me, it is instant hydration and feels so soft. I don't know how to explain it but almost like a silky smooth feeling? I tried a sample of it and went out and bought it instantly the next day!! I would definitely recommend this. I have dry, sensitive skin.
